_doc: Game to shoot for food (docs/survival.md, game; src/smyana/hunting.lobster). Herds are set down five to twelve tiles off the trail. Which game lives where comes from the sources (docs/survival.md lists them): roe deer and wild boar in the beech, oak and fir woods up to about 1,200 m, Balkan chamois on the rocky forested slopes of the Western Rhodopes above about 1,000 m. 'places': each place's herds (the map's place name): a kind, how many herds, how many in a herd (at least, at most), and the seasons it is there in (none: all year). What is shot stays shot: a place is that many fewer when the men come back. 'kinds': each kind's body (data/voxel/bodies; 'winter' in winter), its name for the pointer, 'meat' portions it gives (a portion is a man's day: about a kilo of meat; a roe deer of 25 kg gives about 12, a boar of 80 kg about 30, a chamois of 35 kg about 15) and 'hides' to take home, how far off it notices a man it can see ('notice_tiles') and runs at once if he is nearer than 'flee_tiles', how long it stands and watches first ('alert_s': a man who comes on while it watches, past halfway in from where it saw him, sends it off; one who stands still, it goes back to grazing three times that later), how far it runs ('run_tiles') and how long before it settles ('settle_s'), how far round its place it wanders ('wander_tiles'), and its unit (its hp: a ball does 25, so one hit kills a deer; a boar takes two, and charges the one who hit it). 'butcher_s': seconds a man takes over his share at a carcass; a carcass is shared out into the packs of the men sent to it. 'hear_tiles': how far off game hears a shot and runs.
